title: Design System: Oren Mizrahi, bar mitzvah teacher

headline.purpose: Section titles with one marker phrase.

title.purpose: Step titles in ink blue; legal h2.

body-ruled.purpose: Running paragraphs set on the 2rem notebook ruling, 2rem paragraph spacing.

hand.purpose: Oren's own marks only: name, red-pen notes, captions, signature.

verse.purpose: The pointed verse on the sticky note only (Noto Serif Hebrew subset).

shadows.name: sticker
shadows.purpose: Primary sticker button at rest (white die-cut edge plus soft drop).

shadows.name: polaroid-held
shadows.purpose: Photo held above the page before it lands (motion only).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default state transitions (buttons, links, step marks).

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Entrances: headline rise 1.2s, photo settle 2.4s, verse cross-fade 1.1s, chat messages 0.4s.

motion.name: marker-draw
motion.purpose: Highlighter swipe from the right when a heading enters view.

motion.name: tape-stretch
motion.purpose: Tape stretches on after the photo lands.

motion.name: motion-gate
motion.purpose: Every animation and transition is skipped; elements show their final state; the parochet and yad are not shown.

components.name: Sticker Button (Primary)
components.description: The WhatsApp call to action: an ink-blue sticker with a white die-cut edge, tilted -1deg.
components.html: דברו עם אורן בוואטסאפ
components.css: .ds-btn-sticker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: .85rem 1.75rem; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--terracotta, #1f3a8a); color: #fff; font-family: Assistant, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; text-decoration: none; direction: rtl; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #ffffff, 0 7px 16px -7px rgb(20 30 60 / .45); transform: rotate(-1deg); transition: background-color .35s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), transform .35s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), box-shadow .35s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); } .ds-btn-sticker:hover { background: var(--terracotta-dark, #162b6b); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #ffffff, 0 12px 22px -8px rgb(20 30 60 / .45); transform: rotate(-1deg) translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-sticker:active { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #ffffff, 0 3px 8px -4px rgb(20 30 60 / .45); transform: rotate(-1deg) translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-sticker:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--terracotta-dark, #162b6b); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-sticker { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Inline link: bold ink blue with a thin red-pen underline.
components.html: רוצים לראות איך זה עובד? המשיכו לגלול.
components.css: .ds-link-p { font-family: Assistant, system-ui, sans-serif; direction: rtl; color: var(--muted, #4a5068); font-size: 1.05rem; } .ds-link { color: var(--terracotta, #1f3a8a); font-weight: 700; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: .3em; text-decoration-color: var(--gold, #c2412d); transition: color .3s, text-decoration-color .3s; } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--terracotta-dark, #162b6b); text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--terracotta-dark, #162b6b); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Header nav on paper; current section in ink blue with a red-pen underline; mobile toggle is a blue-ruled square.
components.html: היום הגדולאיך זה עובדהמלצותאודות
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .25rem; direction: rtl; background: var(--cream, #fdfcf7); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(150 170 215 / .7); padding: .4rem 1rem; font-family: Assistant, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding-inline: .8rem; color: var(--ink, #1c2236); font-weight: 600; font-size: .98rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--terracotta, #1f3a8a); } .ds-nav a[aria-current] { color: var(--terracotta, #1f3a8a); } .ds-nav a[aria-current]::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline: .8rem; bottom: .45rem; height: 2px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--gold, #c2412d); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-nav-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--terracotta-dark, #162b6b); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-nav-toggle { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; margin-inline-end: .5rem; border: 2px solid var(--terracotta, #1f3a8a); border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--terracotta, #1f3a8a); cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Highlighted Heading
components.description: Section title in Rubik with one phrase swiped by a two-layer yellow marker with uneven ends.
components.css: .ds-heading { font-family: Rubik, Assistant, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 2.4rem; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--ink, #1c2236); text-align: center; direction: rtl; margin: 0; } .ds-hl { padding-inline: .12em; background-image: linear-gradient(178.4deg, transparent 55%, var(--highlight, #f8dd6b) 55% 89%, transparent 89%), linear-gradient(181.2deg, transparent 60%, rgb(248 221 107 / .55) 60% 93%, transparent 93%); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: 100% 0; background-size: 100% 100%; border-radius: .2em .6em .25em .7em / .15em .4em .2em .45em; -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone; box-decoration-break: clone; }

components.name: Polaroid
components.description: A photo taped into the notebook: white frame, deep bottom margin, tilt, yellow tape and a handwritten caption.
components.css: .ds-polaroid { position: relative; width: 14rem; margin: 1.5rem auto; padding: .6rem .6rem 2.8rem; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 16px 30px -16px rgb(20 30 60 / .5); transform: rotate(1.5deg); direction: rtl; } .ds-polaroid::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -.8rem; left: 50%; width: 6.5rem; height: 1.7rem; margin-left: -3.25rem; border-radius: 2px; background: rgb(248 221 107 / .75); transform: rotate(-4deg); } .ds-polaroid-img { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #cfd6e6, #8d97b0); } .ds-polaroid-cap { position: absolute; bottom: .55rem; inset-inline-start: 1rem; font-family: 'Gveret Levin', Rubik, sans-serif; font-size: 1.45rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--terracotta, #1f3a8a); }

components.name: Hand Note
components.description: Oren's red-pen note in his handwriting, rotated -3deg, with a hand-drawn arrow.
components.html: האח הגדול בדרך
components.css: .ds-note { margin: 0; direction: rtl; font-family: 'Gveret Levin', Rubik, sans-serif; font-size: 1.9rem; line-height: 1.2; color: var(--gold, #c2412d); transform: rotate(-3deg); } .ds-note svg { display: inline-block; width: 1.5em; height: .7em; vertical-align: middle; margin-inline-start: .15em; }

components.name: Step Checkbox
components.description: Steps as a notebook to-do list: square ink-blue checkbox; active fills blue; goal gets a red-pen check.
components.html: 12
components.css: .ds-steps { display: flex; gap: 2rem; direction: rtl; padding: 1rem; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold-soft, #b8c6e6) 0 6px, transparent 6px 11px) center / 100% 1px no-repeat; } .ds-check { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; border: 2px solid var(--terracotta, #1f3a8a); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--cream, #fdfcf7); color: var(--terracotta, #1f3a8a); font-family: Rubik, Assistant, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.1rem; transition: background-color .6s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), color .6s; } .ds-check.is-active { background: var(--terracotta, #1f3a8a); color: #fff; } .ds-check-goal { border-color: var(--gold, #c2412d); color: var(--gold, #c2412d); } .ds-check-goal svg { width: 1.35rem; height: 1.35rem; }

components.name: Verse Sticky Note
components.description: The verse on a yellow sticky note, with its stage caption.
components.css: .ds-sticky { max-width: 34rem; margin: 1rem auto; padding: 1rem 1rem .9rem; text-align: center; direction: rtl; background: #fff4b8; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 10px 18px -12px rgb(20 30 60 / .45); } .ds-sticky-verse { margin: 0; font-family: 'Noto Serif Hebrew', Rubik, serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 2.6rem; line-height: 1.9; color: var(--ink, #1c2236); } .ds-sticky-cap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: .1rem; font-family: Assistant, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: .9rem; color: var(--muted, #4a5068); } .ds-sticky-cap b { color: var(--terracotta, #1f3a8a); } .ds-sticky-cap span { font-size: .82rem; }

components.name: Chat Bubbles
components.description: Testimonial as an incoming WhatsApp bubble, and the outgoing pre-written message in light blue.
components.html: היי אורן, הגעתי מהאתר ואשמח לשמוע על הכנה לבר מצווה לבן שלי
components.css: .ds-chat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .9rem; padding: 1rem; direction: rtl; background: #f3f1ea; font-family: Assistant, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-bubble-in { position: relative; align-self: flex-start; max-width: 92%; margin: 0 8px 0 0; padding: .6rem .8rem .7rem; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 14px; border-start-start-radius: 3px; box-shadow: 0 1px 1.5px rgb(20 30 60 / .14); } .ds-bubble-in figcaption { font-size: .82rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--terracotta, #1f3a8a); } .ds-bubble-in p { margin: 0; font-size: .95rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--ink, #1c2236); } .ds-bubble-out { align-self: flex-end; max-width: 88%; margin: 0; padding: .8rem 1rem; background: #dfe7f8; color: var(--ink, #1c2236); font-size: 1.02rem; line-height: 1.6; border-radius: 18px; border-end-end-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgb(20 30 60 / .06), 0 6px 16px -10px rgb(20 30 60 / .25); }

components.name: Accessibility Option
components.description: Toggle in the accessibility panel; pressed state fills ink blue.
components.css: .ds-a11y { display: grid; gap: .45rem; width: 15rem; padding: 1rem; direction: rtl; background: var(--cream, #fdfcf7); border: 1px solid var(--gold-soft, #b8c6e6); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -18px rgb(20 30 60 / .45); } .ds-a11y-opt { min-height: 44px; padding-inline: .8rem; text-align: start; border: 1px solid var(--gold-soft, #b8c6e6); border-radius: 10px; background: #ffffff; color: var(--ink, #1c2236); font: 600 .95rem/1.2 Assistant, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-a11y-opt:hover { border-color: var(--terracotta, #1f3a8a); } .ds-a11y-opt[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--terracotta, #1f3a8a); border-color: var(--terracotta, #1f3a8a); color: #fff; } .ds-a11y-opt:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--terracotta-dark, #162b6b); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Big Brother's Notebook"**

The site is a page out of an older brother's Hebrew school notebook: warm off-white paper ruled in faint blue every 2rem, a red margin line on the right (the RTL side, where a Hebrew notebook keeps it), headings written in one confident ink blue, key phrases swiped with a yellow highlighter, and Oren's own notes in red pen in his handwriting. Photos are polaroids taped onto the page; the main button is a blue sticker stuck on slightly crooked. It reads as personal and close, a teenager who is serious about the work, never as a school brochure or a template.

Playfulness lives in the materials (paper, marker, tape, pen) and never in the copy. The serious work is done by the words, the Torah material and the verse: the verse sits on a yellow sticky note and sheds its cantillation and then its vowels across the three steps, a Torah yad pointer follows the words of the first story paragraph as it scrolls, and the testimonials arrive as a WhatsApp conversation on Oren's phone. The notebook frames these; it does not compete with them. The approved opening is the exception to the paper world: a full-screen burgundy velvet parochet with an embroidered gold frame, dragged open into light, after which the notebook appears.

Density is calm and single-column on mobile (where parents arrive from a WhatsApp link), opening to two columns on desktop. Every path ends in one WhatsApp message.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled paper is the ground on every page; running text sits exactly on the 2rem rules.
One deep colour (ink blue) carries headings, buttons and Oren's name; red pen is for decoration and notes only.
Yellow marker highlights the one phrase in each heading that matters.
Handwriting (Gveret Levin) is Oren's voice: his name, his notes, his signature. Never body copy.
Physical objects (sticker, polaroid, tape, sticky note) carry soft, low shadows and slight rotations.
Hebrew RTL first; every motion has a still final state.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Ink blue is the only deep colour for anything a parent must read as an action or a heading accent. Red pen never fills a button or carries running text.

rules.name: The One Swipe Rule
rules.body: The yellow marker highlights one phrase per heading (the hero's "הבן שלכם הבא." and each section title). It is never a panel fill or a background.

rules.name: The Legacy Names Rule
rules.body: In code the variables keep older names: `--cream` is paper, `--terracotta` is ink blue, `--terracotta-dark` is the deep blue, `--gold` is the red pen, `--gold-soft` is the rule blue, `--highlight` is the marker. Use the variables, read them by these meanings.

rules.name: The Never Frank Ruhl Rule
rules.body: Frank Ruhl Libre is never used, anywhere, for any role (client decision).

rules.name: The Hand Is Oren Rule
rules.body: Gveret Levin is reserved for Oren's own marks: his name, notes, captions and signature. It never sets body copy, buttons or navigation. Under the "readable font" option it falls back to Assistant 700.

rules.name: The Ruled Line Rule
rules.body: Running text sits on the 2rem rules. Paragraph spacing is one rule (2rem), not an arbitrary margin.

rules.name: The Lying-On-Paper Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is a soft, downward, cool-tinted blur under a physical object. No hard offset shadows, no coloured shadows, no glows.

dos: **Do** keep ruled paper (1px rule every 2rem, red margin on the right) as the ground of every page, and set running text at a 2rem line-height on it.
**Do** use ink blue (`ink-blue`) as the one deep colour for headings' accents, buttons and Oren's name.
**Do** give each heading at most one yellow marker phrase, swiped from the right.
**Do** keep Gveret Levin for Oren's own marks: name, notes, captions, signature.
**Do** make physical objects (sticker, polaroid, tape, sticky note) feel placed: small rotations and soft, cool, downward shadows.
**Do** write Hebrew RTL first, with logical properties (`inset-inline`, `padding-inline-start`).
**Do** meet IS 5568 / WCAG 2.1 AA: 44px minimum targets, a visible 3px focus outline, AA contrast, and keyboard and screen-reader paths for every interaction.
**Do** skip every animation and transition under `prefers-reduced-motion` and under the site's own "stop animations" option, showing each element in its final state.
donts: **Don't** use Frank Ruhl Libre, in any role (client decision).
**Don't** use long dashes (em or en dash) in copy.
**Don't** fill buttons or set body text in red pen; it is for notes and decoration.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows or coloured shadows; the sticker's only edge is its 3px white die-cut.
**Don't** let the playful materials replace the serious content; the copy, the Torah material and the verse carry the weight.
**Don't** add the word-following yad to more running text; it belongs to the story lead only.
**Don't** bring the parochet's velvet and gold into the notebook; they belong to the opening only.
**Don't** add a logo, invented testimonials, numbers or images.
